purpose: Document independently read older source semantics; not a new outcome calculation.
actual_instrument_rows_definition: Count rows with nonmissing instrument ISIN, instrument name and asset type; aggregate all retained input chunks by fund and quarter.
old_f35_fund_support: Require nonempty q0/q1/q2 reports, nonblank stable fund ISIN, and no identified invalid unit in any of the four fixed roles.
logical_zero_rule: Instrument absent in a supported nonempty report and accepted instrument identity is coded zero under the existing source convention. Missing or empty report does not establish zero.
remaining_assumption: Nonempty report presence is not external proof of exhaustive or error-free reporting. All bounds also condition on valid original q1 quantities and identity, including unsupported q2 cells.

frozen_field_clarification.verified_complete_report_absences: Accepted nonempty-report support, not independent certification that reporting is exhaustive.
frozen_field_clarification.independently_rebuilt_report_cells: Repeated event-fund-quarter checks, not distinct fund reports.
